study: AfriShield Africa Safari & Hotel AI Visibility Index

sample.selection: Seven safari operators and hotels audited individually by AfriShield AI between 14 September and 14 October 2026. Not a random sample. Businesses are anonymised: each audit was prepared for the business itself.

method.scores: Four pillars scored 0-100 per business: Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, GEO / AI Readiness, plus an overall GEO score and a 25-point Trust Stack. Technical and On-Page were scored check by check from served HTML, response headers, robots.txt, sitemaps and JSON-LD. Off-Page is an estimate from public listings, without a backlink database.
method.rankings: Live Google searches for each business's own name and for the commercial phrases that describe what it sells. Search depth varied by audit (top 10 to top 50), so 'page one' here means the top 10 organic results.
method.ai_answers: Sampled directly for three businesses (Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity). For the other four, AI readiness was assessed from the machine-readable files the site publishes, not from sampled assistant answers.
method.limits: Seven businesses is a pilot, not a census. Scores describe the audit date. Search results vary by location and day.
